reviewSamples.author: Photo of Lori Gormin
reviewSamples.text: We needed to have our master bathroom remodeled and retiled. Chris J came to us highly recommended. His reputation is very well deserved. He did a beautiful job, and he did it on budget. When some unexpected problems that could not have been anticipated appeared, he remained patient and calm. In fact, his only concern was our state of minds about the small bit of extra time the job needed. His professionalism and attention to detail makes him one of the finest craftsman we have ever had the privilege to deal with. Also, I am very happy to report, his costs were quite reasonable.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Michael Banyas
reviewSamples.text: WOW!!! What an amazing bathroom transformation by Chris Johnson at CJ Ceramic Tile.  The finished product exceeded my original expectations.  Chris's skill, workmanship, and pride in his work showed throughout the process.  He strives for perfection and he overcame every obstacle including un-straight walls and unexpected damage to 2x4s found during tear-out.  My thanks goes out to Chris for his professionalism and a job well done.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Ken DeCerchio
reviewSamples.text: Chris did a beautiful job on backsplash in our kitchen. The cuts around the wood trim were very small and intricate. Chris takes a lot of pride in doing his work the right way. He’s a craftsman. Get him to do your job if you can.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Joseph Alvarez
reviewSamples.text: Chris does amazing work and has transformed my master bathroom. He provides expertise and guidance in regards to bathroom remodel. Even if he lacks first hand knowledge, Chris has many connections that can help turn your design into reality. Chris was very responsive to both text and phone calls, and was always clear about his schedule and expected completion of the project. He works mainly with tile, but with the assistance of his fellow contractors anything can be accomplished. I truly can't thank Chris enough for his help in remodeling my bathroom.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Pedro Rebolledo
reviewSamples.text: CJ is an absolute class act. He promptly came in yesterday for an estimate on a bathroom flooring project for my house and quickly determined my issue was not the flooring but rather plumbing. He went beyond just letting me know that and throughly helped me identify the leak (saving me $ on leak detection)  and recommended me a quality plumber. He charged me nothing for his help and left with a smile. Very hard to find quality contractors that truly care about their work and their customer rather than just sell you on a remodel. Will use him 100x moving forward.
